#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Tun Interface Monitor
# Polls for the expected tun device and configures it when the SSH client
# establishes a tunnel connection. Re-configures if the device reappears
# after a disconnect.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

TUN_DEV="${TUN_DEV:-tun0}"
TUN_LOCAL_IP="${TUN_LOCAL_IP:-10.10.10.2}"
TUN_REMOTE_IP="${TUN_REMOTE_IP:-10.10.10.1}"
TUN_MTU="${TUN_MTU:-1340}"
INTERVAL="${TUN_MONITOR_INTERVAL:-5}"

log() {
    echo "[tun-monitor] $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $*"
}

log "Started — watching for ${TUN_DEV} every ${INTERVAL}s"
log "Will configure: IP ${TUN_LOCAL_IP} peer ${TUN_REMOTE_IP}, MTU ${TUN_MTU}"

was_up=0

while true; do
    if ip link show "${TUN_DEV}" &>/dev/null; then
        # Device exists — check if IP is already set
        if ! ip addr show "${TUN_DEV}" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'inet '; then
            log "${TUN_DEV} appeared — configuring..."

            # Assign point-to-point IP
            if ip addr add "${TUN_LOCAL_IP}/32" peer "${TUN_REMOTE_IP}" \
                    dev "${TUN_DEV}" 2>/dev/null; then
                log "  IP set: ${TUN_LOCAL_IP} <-> ${TUN_REMOTE_IP}"
            else
                log "  WARN: IP assignment failed (may already be set)"
            fi

            # Set MTU
            if ip link set "${TUN_DEV}" mtu "${TUN_MTU}" 2>/dev/null; then
                log "  MTU set to ${TUN_MTU}"
            fi

            # Bring interface up
            if ip link set "${TUN_DEV}" up 2>/dev/null; then
                log "  ${TUN_DEV} is UP"
            fi

            # Re-apply IP forwarding (safety — may be reset)
            echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward 2>/dev/null || true

            # Log final state
            addr_info=$(ip addr show "${TUN_DEV}" 2>/dev/null | grep 'inet ' || echo "unknown")
            log "  ${TUN_DEV} configured: ${addr_info}"
            was_up=1

        elif [[ $was_up -eq 0 ]]; then
            # Already had IP when we first noticed it
            addr_info=$(ip addr show "${TUN_DEV}" 2>/dev/null | grep 'inet ' | xargs || echo "unknown")
            log "${TUN_DEV} already configured: ${addr_info}"
            was_up=1
        fi

    else
        # Device does not exist
        if [[ $was_up -eq 1 ]]; then
            log "${TUN_DEV} disappeared — client disconnected. Waiting for reconnect..."
            was_up=0
        fi
    fi

    sleep "${INTERVAL}"
done
